subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.**

The shareholders are planning to ___________ control of the company from the current directors.
solution: The correct answer is: **Wrest** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Wrest **means to take something away from someone by using force or skill. (बल या कौशल का प्रयोग करके किसी से कुछ छीन लेना) • **Example**: *He managed to wrest control of the company from his competitors through strategic negotiations.* • The verb "**wrest**" is commonly used in business contexts to refer to taking control or power away from someone else. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. **Complete sentence**: *The shareholders are planning to wrest __control of the company from the current directors.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Roost **refers to a place where birds perch or settle for the night. (ऐसी जगह जहां पक्षी रात के लिए बसेरा करते हैं या बसते हैं) • **Roast **can also be used as a noun to refer to a piece of roasted meat. (भुने हुए मांस का एक टुकड़ा) • **Rest **can also be used as a noun to refer to a period of relaxation or sleep. (विश्राम या नींद की अवधि) 34:Tb7c, The correct answer is: **Impackted**
